data.body: Sizing RCA before push: the current 1 GiB constant is under-sized. On current origin/main with the exact macOS selectors, 3 workers, required extras, and explicit basetemps, the default tier retained 1,138,012 KiB across 233,910 files; integration passed 167/2-skipped and retained 1,139,044 KiB across 25,863 files. Keeping both trees consumes 2,277,056 KiB (2.171 GiB), so neither 1 GiB nor 2 GiB with both trees satisfies the >=50% headroom AC. The integration footprint is dominated by the intentional 141 MiB incompressible partial-clone fixture replicated across xdist workers. Because the tiers run sequentially, the safe repair is to use a 2 GiB APFS volume, report and remove the exact successful default basetemp before integration, then retain the integration tree until always-run final reporting/detach. This keeps each tier's measured ~1.086 GiB peak below 2 GiB with ~87% headroom and preserves a failed default tree for diagnostics because later success-only steps do not run after failure. No selector, test, worker, timeout, platform, assertion, or coverage behavior changes.
